mapping_policy: Wokann defines gBattleFrontierTrainers as fixed 0x34-byte BattleFrontierTrainer records. trainerName is an 8-byte field at offset 4. The verified ROM table starts at 0x085B4A10; every original field matches baserom_jp.gba. Each replacement is compact Chinese (F5 + up to three two-byte glyphs + FF padding), so it remains within the original 8-byte field and changes display-only data.
